summary: Reviewed aeeca457 on top of origin/master 63449a8b. The change swaps decodeReview for decodeRequestEvidence in Auditor evidence validation so immutable legacy forest.review-request.v1 refs (issue/branch/revision/time) are tolerated during the read-only sweep, while v2 decodeReview remains the gate authority (verifyEvidenceGate still rejects v1 for master). New test proves legacy v1 is accepted and an unknown v2 key still yields a violation. Checks build/vet/test/secrets all exit 0 and merge-base origin/master is an ancestor, so the Revision can fast-forward. No blocking findings.
